facts: Parties: Delamere Media Ltd (Buyer), Eskdale Industries Ltd (Seller); the Company is Foxley Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 11 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $203,180,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $1,200,000.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
